nameOrigin: sound a cat makes when content

pokedexEntries.bk: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

pokedexEntries.wh: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

pokedexEntries.sw: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

pokedexEntries.za: Purrloin steals from people for fun, but its behavior is so charming that its victims can't help but forgive it.
